### `class CatalogueReloadListener` — `fabric/src/main/java/villager_voices/fabric/catalogue/CatalogueReloadListener.java`
Loads data/villager_voices/reaction/.json through Minecraft's own resource/datapack system into a Catalogue (docs/spec/domains/reaction.md "Data format" §3), the thin per-loader shim `common`'s own codec deliberately leaves out.
